t: An animation app for making stop-motion movies with figures, clay, and paper.
steps: Find the app in your device's app store or on the vendor's school page.
Ask IT to deploy it by VPP, Google Admin, or Windows tools.
Activate the app. The internet is needed at setup.
Check the official page for the current price of the Pro version.
Set up a stand or tripod to keep the camera steady.
Try a short test movie with clay or paper.
Browse the vendor's education lessons for your grade.
